policies.title: Brazilian common passports: Panama short-visit visa exemption
policies.summary: Panama's current embassy immigration guidance names Brazil in its no-visa visitor-country list for stays of up to three months.
conditions: Ordinary Brazilian passport holder, visitor stay of up to three months; carry the stated passport validity, return/onward travel and funds where requested.
Employment, residence, transit, conditional third-country visa or residence routes, special passports and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Brazilian common passports: North Macedonia short-visit visa exemption
policies.summary: The reciprocal Brazil–Macedonia agreement exempts Brazilian nationals holding valid national passports for tourism, holiday or business stays up to 90 days per semester.
conditions: Use a valid ordinary Brazilian national passport for tourism, holiday or business travel, for a continuous stay or total subsequent stays of no more than 90 days per semester from first entry.
Paid employment and stays over 90 days require the appropriate visa. Diplomatic, official, service, temporary and other special-document arrangements are outside this ordinary-passport policy.
